key_insight: A combined experimental and computational approach assesses welded-joint integrity by accounting for interacting defects, material heterogeneity, and off-axis stresses.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports more realistic integrity assessments of welds containing multiple defects rather than isolated flaws.
method: Experimentally test welded joints with multiple defects.
Monitor deformation using digital image correlation.
Develop finite element models incorporating material heterogeneity, defect-initiated cracks, and off-axis stresses.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes model development from simple 2D representations to richer analyses but reports no quantitative results or validation metrics.
watch_item: Predictive accuracy and transferability to service conditions require validation beyond the methodological description provided.
paper_title: Combined approach for integrity assessment of welded joints with multiple defects
